# Crest AI Readiness Services

Crest AI Readiness Services helps healthcare software companies make their product pages easier for answer engines to crawl, understand, cite, and route to sales actions.

## Managed AI Readiness Service

Crest provides a managed AI readiness service for B2B software teams.

## Product Metadata Platform

The Product Metadata Platform publishes structured product and service data for AI systems.

Pricing starts at $8,000 per month for managed readiness programs.

## FAQ

Q: What does Crest generate for AI systems?
A: Crest generates llms.txt, Schema.org JSON-LD, action metadata, and a hosted AI-readable profile.

Q: Does Crest replace the customer website?
A: No. Crest hosts the AI-readable business profile while the customer website remains the source.

## Trust

According to Crest's public methodology, every generated claim should map back to source text.
